The proposal addresses both critique findings: it separates multipart part size from aws-chunked frame size—the MinIO report’s reproduction is `PutObject`, and its linked PR is closed, not merged ([issue](https://github.com/minio/minio/issues/21611), [PR](https://github.com/minio/minio/pull/21626)); and it carries abort-race reconciliation through every cleanup path, using repeated abort and `ListParts` checks ([AWS API](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_AbortMultipartUpload.html)). Validation remains proposed; no implementation or tests were run.
